spec.name: hb-it-sang-to-us-we
spec.title: The Hollow Brood: It sang to us... we drank... and it gave, and gave
spec.speaker: speaker.mother-ashka

request.text: [dying] [whispers] It sang to us... we drank... and it gave, and gave...

text: It sang to us... we drank... and it gave, and gave...

voice.description: An ancient matron who was once warm and motherly, now changed and lost in a dream: an old woman's low, cracked voice, rasping and wet, drifting between whispers and sudden loud cries, dazed and haunted, as if hearing a song no one else can hear. Slow, uneven, unsettling but sad rather than evil. She speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.
